_comment: Machine-type detection anchors. Each anchor is a binarized template compared (XOR diff ratio) against the binarized frame crop at 'coords'. Anchors are checked in list order; the first one whose diff < diff_threshold produces a vote. A machine type is confirmed after 'consecutive_votes' identical votes in a row. If the frame buffer exceeds 'max_buffer_frames' before confirmation, 'fallback_machine_id' is used.
